source: claude-api skill, Current Models table (cached 2026-10-06): Anthropic first-party API list prices, USD per million tokens
note: Notional: list prices applied to traced tokens, not a bill. Cache writes are priced at input x cache_write_multiplier (5-minute cache) or x cache_write_1h_multiplier (1-hour cache, which Claude Code's main thread uses), per the claude-api skill's prompt-caching reference; traces stored before 2026-10-15 don't split writes by TTL and are priced at the 5-minute rate. Haiku 5.5's prices hold for prompts up to 100K tokens (0.50 / 2.50 beyond) and its cache read is the documented ~0.1x of input.
